item.title: Wisconsin spoils Purdue Senior Day, beating Boilers 97-93
item.description: WEST LAFAYETTE, Ind. (WISH) — The No. 15 Purdue Boilermakers came up just short against Wisconsin on Senior Day, losing to the Badgers, 97-93. item.title: Body found in ditch near State Road 135 in Greenwood
item.description: A body was found in a drainage ditch near Swartz Crossing and State Road 135 in Greenwood, Indiana, on March 6, 2026, and the Johnson County coroner on Monday will work to identify the person and conduct an autopsy.

item.title: Public asked to help find missing 17-year-old runaway Penelope McGowan from Plainfield
item.description: Police are searching for 17-year-old Penelope McGowan, who was last seen leaving school with her sister and has not been in contact with friends or family since.

item.title: Man missing after airboat capsizes in Jackson County floodwaters
item.description: A man went missing in Jackson County, Indiana, floodwaters after an airboat capsized while attempting to assist people stranded in a submerged vehicle. Search efforts were being hampered by high water levels, swift currents and floating debris.

item.title: Downtown shooting leaves 1 in critical condition, 1 arrested
item.description: A person is in critical condition after being shot in Downtown Indianapolis early Saturday morning, and one person was detained on the scene.

item.title: Showers fade tonight then a spring surge builds toward midweek storms | Mar. 7, 2026
item.description: The weekend starts off damp and cool, but gradually improves with dry roads, mild temperatures, and sunshine, before becoming unsettled with rain and thunderstorms by Tuesday and Wednesday.

item.title: Ball State fires men’s basketball head coach Michael Lewis
item.description: Ball State announced it is parting ways with men's basketball head coach Michael Lewis after four seasons, during which the team's win total decreased from 20-12 in his first season to 12-19 this season.

item.title: Reports: Colts trade Zaire Franklin to Packers
item.description: The Colts have traded linebacker Zaire Franklin to the Packers in exchange for defensive tackle Colby Wooden.

item.title: 1 dead and 4 people detained after shooting on Indy’s northeast side
item.description: Four people were arrested after a person was shot and found in critical condition on Indy's northeast side early Saturday morning.

item.title: Juvenile male in critical condition after near west side shooting
item.description: One person is in critical condition after being shot at 1165 N. Tibbs Ave. in Indianapolis, and police are investigating.
